scope: 55 canonical products. Distinct annual editions are not substituted or counted as additional canonical products.
method: Bounded Commons title/category/API search and selected Open Food Facts barcode/brand lookups, followed by visual label/side review, license metadata review and pinned local bytes. Candidate counts are retrieval results, not accepted photographs. A second targeted pass visually reviewed retailer/manufacturer image bytes, decoded visible barcodes locally to improve OFF lookups and retained verified external-only image metadata with rights caveats.
